## Setup
Validate the restaurant key, ensure the Asaas webhook exists, and persist operational state.

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json;const restaurantId=input.request_body.restaurant_id;const asaasApiKey=input.request_body.asaas_api_key;const asaasEnvironment=input.request_body.asaas_environment==='sandbox'?'sandbox':'production';const asaasBaseUrl=asaasEnvironment==='sandbox'?'https://api-sandbox.asaas.com/v3':'https://api.asaas.com/v3';if(!restaurantId||!asaasApiKey){return [{json:{...input,body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'restaurant_id and asaas_api_key are required'}}}];}return [{json:{...input,restaurant_id:restaurantId,asaas_api_key:asaasApiKey,asaas_environment:asaasEnvironment,asaas_base_url:asaasBaseUrl,request_origin:'setup'}}];

const input=$input.first().json;if(input.body?.error){return $input.all();}const restaurant=input;if(!restaurant?.id){return [{json:{...$('Validate Setup Request').first().json,body:{error:'not_found',message:'Restaurant not found'}}}];}const setup=$('Validate Setup Request').first().json;return [{json:{...setup,restaurant,asaas_api_key:setup.asaas_api_key,asaas_environment:setup.asaas_environment,asaas_base_url:setup.asaas_base_url}}];

const input=$input.first().json;const list=Array.isArray(input)?input:(input.data??input.items??input.webhooks??[]);const webhookList=Array.isArray(list)?list:(list.data??list.items??list.webhooks??[]);const requiredWebhookUrl=($env.VAPT_N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL??'https://replace-me.example.com/webhook').replace(/\/$/,'') + '/asaas/webhook';const existingWebhook=webhookList.find((entry)=>entry.url===requiredWebhookUrl)??null;const token=$('Normalize Asaas Account').first().json.restaurant?.asaas_webhook_token??globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.()??`${$('Normalize Asaas Account').first().json.restaurant.id}-${Date.now()}`;return [{json:{...$('Normalize Asaas Account').first().json,required_webhook_url:requiredWebhookUrl,required_webhook_token:token,existing_webhook,existing_webhook_id:existingWebhook?.id??null}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { name: 'Vapt ' + $json.restaurant.name + ' Pix Webhook', url: $json.required_webhook_url, email: 'cliente-vapt@vapt.com.br', sendType: 'SEQUENTIALLY', enabled: true, interrupted: false, authToken: $json.required_webhook_token, events: ['PAYMENT_RECEIVED', 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED'] } }}

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json;if(input.body?.error){return [{json:input.body}];}let origin='setup';try{origin=$('Validate Setup Request').first().json.request_origin??origin;}catch{try{origin=$('Build Refresh Context').first().json.request_origin??origin;}catch{}}let webhookId=null;try{webhookId=$('Normalize Created Webhook').first().json.resolved_webhook_id??null;}catch{try{webhookId=$('Normalize Existing Webhooks').first().json.existing_webhook_id??null;}catch{}}return [{json:{valid:true,webhook_registered:true,webhook_id:webhookId,setup_status:'ready',message:origin==='admin_refresh'?'Asaas revalidado com sucesso':'Asaas configurado com sucesso'}}];

## Admin Refresh
Internal rerun of the setup contract using the stored restaurant key.

## Pix Create
Authenticated app flow that creates the Pix payment, fetches the QR payload, and stores order payment metadata.

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json;const restaurantId=input.request_body.restaurant_id??input.request_query.restaurant_id;const orderId=input.request_body.order_id??input.request_query.order_id;if(!restaurantId||!orderId){return [{json:{...input,body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'restaurant_id and order_id are required'}}}];}return [{json:{...input,restaurant_id:restaurantId,order_id:orderId}}];

const order=$input.first().json;const pixInput=$('Validate Pix Create Request').first().json;const restaurant=$('Get Pix Restaurant').first().json;if(!restaurant?.id||!order?.id){return [{json:{...pixInput,body:{error:'not_found',message:'Restaurant or order not found'}}}];}if(restaurant.asaas_setup_status!=='ready'||!restaurant.asaas_api_key){return [{json:{...pixInput,body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'Asaas is not configured for this restaurant'}}}];}const asaasBillingDocument=restaurant.asaas_billing_document??restaurant.cnpj??null;if(!asaasBillingDocument){return [{json:{...pixInput,body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'Configure um CPF ou CNPJ operacional do Asaas antes de gerar Pix'}}}];}const asaasEnvironment=restaurant.asaas_environment==='sandbox'?'sandbox':'production';const asaasBaseUrl=asaasEnvironment==='sandbox'?'https://api-sandbox.asaas.com/v3':'https://api.asaas.com/v3';return [{json:{...pixInput,restaurant,order,asaas_api_key:restaurant.asaas_api_key,asaas_environment:asaasEnvironment,asaas_base_url:asaasBaseUrl,asaas_billing_document:asaasBillingDocument}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const rawValue = $json.order?.total_price ?? $json.request_body?.total_price ?? $json.total_price ?? $json.order?.totalPrice ?? $json.request_body?.totalPrice ?? $json.totalPrice; const value = Number.parseFloat(String(rawValue ?? '').replace(',', '.')); return { customer: $json.asaas_customer?.id ?? $json.customer?.id ?? $json.customer_id, billingType: 'PIX', value, dueDate: '2026-12-31', externalReference: $json.order?.id ?? $json.order_id }; })() }}

parameters.jsCode: const qr=$input.first().json;const base=$('Normalize Customer Lookup').first().json;const payment=$('Create Pix Payment').first().json;const orderPatch={payment_status:'PENDING'};if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(base.order,'payment_id')){orderPatch.payment_id=base.order.payment_id??payment.id??null;}if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(base.order,'pix_payload')){orderPatch.pix_payload=qr.payload??qr.encodedPayload??null;}if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(base.order,'qr_code_base64')){orderPatch.qr_code_base64=qr.encodedImage??qr.base64Image??null;}const eventPayload={provider:'asaas',provider_event_id:`pix_create:${payment.id??base.order.id}`,event_type:'PIX_CREATED',restaurant_id:base.restaurant.id,order_id:base.order.id,payload:{payment,pix_qr:qr}};return [{json:{...base,payment,pix_qr:qr,order_patch:orderPatch,event_payload:eventPayload}}];

## Webhook
Validate the stored token, persist a deduplicated event audit row, and update the order idempotently.

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json;const payment=input.request_body.payment??input.request_body.paymentData??input.request_body??{};const externalReference=payment.externalReference??input.request_body.externalReference??null;if(!externalReference){return [{json:{...input,body:{error:'invalid_configuration',message:'Webhook payload is missing externalReference'}}}];}return [{json:{...input,external_reference:externalReference,asaas_event:input.request_body.event??input.request_body.type??null,payment_payload:payment}}];

const order=$('Get Webhook Order').first().json;const restaurant=$('Get Webhook Restaurant').first().json;const input=$('Normalize Asaas Webhook Payload').first().json;const provided=input.request_headers['asaas-access-token']??input.request_headers['Asaas-Access-Token'];if(!restaurant?.asaas_webhook_token||provided!==restaurant.asaas_webhook_token){return [{json:{body:{error:'unauthorized',message:'Invalid Asaas webhook token'}}}];}return [{json:{...input,order,restaurant,event_type:input.asaas_event,payment:input.payment_payload,provider_event_id:`asaas:${input.external_reference}:${input.asaas_event??'payment'}`}}];
